instruction:
Two-Storey Apartment Split Conversion Schedule

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited room schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 6 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 4 IfcDoor entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: APT-101-LIVING, APT-101-KITCHEN, APT-101-BED, APT-201-LIVING, APT-201-KITCHEN, and APT-201-BED.
7. APT-101-LIVING, APT-101-KITCHEN, and APT-101-BED are assigned to one storey, and APT-201-LIVING, APT-201-KITCHEN, and APT-201-BED are assigned to the other storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, -0.048] and max [14.0, 4.0, 6.6].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: RoomNumber, RoomName, Area.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 6 data rows in this order: 101-L APT-101-LIVING 20.0, 101-K APT-101-KITCHEN 20.0, 101-B APT-101-BED 16.0, 201-L APT-201-LIVING 20.0, 201-K APT-201-KITCHEN 20.0, and 201-B APT-201-BED 16.0, each Area value with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
11. The sum of all schedule Area values is between 111.0 m2 and 113.0 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
